'''Den Hardon''' was a criminal who was wanted by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gornt Seron]]. Hiring [[Kin Laron]] to assassinate Hardon sometime after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Laron was able to intercept Hardon's ship while it was fleeing for the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Laron breached the ship's hull, dropping canisters of [[RX-8]] gas, which eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] Hardon.
